reason: Pinned application CI exposed a repository-inventory representation failure after the mathematical case study was written. This amendment keeps mathematical and process diagnoses separate and updates final semantic metrology.

process_episode.event: Pinned application suite run #605 failed 1/560 tests after all mathematical artifacts were present.
process_episode.observation: The frozen exact-19 JSON episode inventory test discovered two unexpected JSON objects because the new TaskEpisode used a .json extension and the diagnosis record also exposed a top-level episode_id key.
process_episode.verification: Decoded GitHub Actions job logs identified the sole failure as test_framework_pr153_hash_contract_migration.py::test_episode_inventory_is_the_exact_frozen_19_object_audit; 559 tests passed.

process_diagnosis.statement: A proposal/shadow episode record was semantically valid for the cycle but represented as JSON inside an application repository whose migration assurance intentionally treats top-level episode_id in JSON as governed inventory membership. The diagnosis JSON also accidentally matched that detector.

process_failure.scope: application repository representation/CI only; no mathematical statement or source binding failed
repair: move the proposal/shadow TaskEpisode payload to the established .taskepisode extension
remove top-level episode_id from the non-episode diagnosis record, replacing it with source_episode_ref
update deterministic local assurance to read the .taskepisode record
rerun the full pinned application suite
process_failure.reusable_lesson: Before adding TaskEpisode-style application artifacts, audit repository-wide inventory detectors and extension contracts. A semantically distinct diagnosis record must not accidentally satisfy the syntactic TaskEpisode detector.

episode_diagnosis_obstruction_lesson_sep: The CI process episode and diagnosis are not merged into the mathematical obstruction O-NS-B2a1a2-VISCOSITY-NORMALIZATION-GAIN-DEFICIT. They remain a separate process failure/lesson and have no theorem authority.

framework_vs_application.why: The exact-inventory assurance test correctly rejected an unregistered JSON representation. The repair uses the already-established .taskepisode convention rather than changing RAKL framework semantics.
framework_vs_application.framework_improvement_hypothesis: NONE_WARRANTED: the failure was caught by existing assurance. A future convenience linter for top-level episode_id / extension collisions could reduce iteration cost, but this run does not establish a framework defect requiring isolated RAKL work.
